sourceStudy: Read the complete anuccheda and identify the principal claim concerning the definition of the first nine topics of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.
Identify the central technical definition of the anuccheda and the words in the source that delimit its meaning.
Carefully distinguish Jīva Gosvāmī's voice from scriptural quotations, objections, and editorial comments.
afterReading: Explain in your own words what this anuccheda establishes concerning the definition of the first nine topics of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.
Explain how this definition contributes to identifying the vastu/āśraya that structures the conclusion of Tattva Sandarbha.
Compare your conclusion with your initial understanding: what did you have to refine, correct, or distinguish?
